run_semantics: model-replacement replay of existing fixed requests, not independent held-out accuracy
limitations: Existing output/file scoring does not prove final conversation quality or all requested bindings
English XOR had correct output 99 but used width 32 instead of requested width 8

Known vector programs remain usable without the model
External-provider verification requires an endpoint/model; macOS remains deferred
